svg.title: Cruise velocity: the flat top
svg.desc: Animated, two speed-time graphs drawn left to right together, each with a solid line for the measured free speed. Left, a little below: the dashed profile ramps up to a flat top at about 85% of free speed, and the flat top is highlighted as the cruise velocity, 80-90% of free speed; the measured speed keeps up. Right, too high: the dashed profile's flat top is above the free speed line, the measured speed flattens just under free speed, and the red gap between them shows the profile asking for the impossible: the loop saturates. In MAXMotion cruise velocity is in RPM, scaled by the velocity conversion factor.
svg.text: The profile's top speed. Set it a little below what the mechanism can really do.
A little below: it keeps up
Too high: it can't keep up
80-90% of measured free speed is a safe start. If the cruise velocity is
above what the motor can reach, the profile asks for the impossible and
In MAXMotion it is in RPM, scaled by the velocity conversion factor.
